***Summary:***



The Eligibility Specialist / Care Coordinator is responsible for ensuring clients maintain active and eligible insurance coverage throughout their course of treatment while providing administrative care coordination support. This position plays a critical role in verifying insurance eligibility, monitoring benefit status, assisting clients with eligibility renewal requirements, and coordinating with county agencies, health plans, and referral sources to prevent interruptions in services. The Eligibility Specialist / Care Coordinator works collaboratively with clinical, admissions, and billing staff to ensure compliance with SAPC, DHCS, Drug Medi\-Cal, and other payer requirements while supporting clients in maintaining access to medically necessary treatment.


***Essential Duties and Responsibilities:***



Including, but not limited to, the following described duties \- reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Other duties may be assigned.


* Verify and maintain client insurance eligibility and benefits throughout the duration of treatment.
* Monitor client eligibility status to ensure compliance with current SAPC, DHCS, Drug Medi\-Cal, and health plan requirements, including the 2027 eligibility and enrollment standards.
* Proactively identify clients whose insurance or eligibility is at risk of lapsing and initiate appropriate follow\-up.

* Monitor insurance verification reports and maintain accurate records of eligibility status and benefit information.
* Educate clients regarding insurance requirements, renewal deadlines, and documentation needed to maintain eligibility.
* Collaborate with admissions, counselors, case managers, billing staff, and leadership to ensure clients remain financially and programmatically eligible for services.
* Document all eligibility verification activities, client contacts, and insurance updates in the electronic health record (EHR) and other required tracking systems.
* Maintain accurate tracking spreadsheets, reports, and documentation related to insurance eligibility and client enrollment.
* Assist clients with referrals to community resources when additional assistance is needed to maintain healthcare coverage.

* Participate in team meetings, trainings, audits, and compliance reviews.

* CPR/First Aid certification preferred.

* Minimum of one (1\) year of experience in healthcare eligibility, insurance verification, case management, care coordination, admissions, behavioral health, or a related field preferred.

myPlace Health is built around a simple but powerful belief: older adults deserve the support they need to live safely, independently, and with dignity in their own communities. As a PACE (Program of All Inclusive Care for the Elderly) organization backed by SCAN Group, myPlace Health brings together customized medical care, social activities, and daily support for participants and their families – all under one roof.


Our centers are more than healthcare facilities. They are vibrant community hubs where participants are known by name, valued, and supported as whole people. Behind that experience is a dedicated, interdisciplinary team working together to coordinate care, remove barriers, and improve quality of life for some of the most medically and socially complex populations.


For employees, myPlace Health offers the opportunity to do deeply meaningful work in a highly collaborative setting. Team members are encouraged to contribute innovative ideas, and grow alongside a mission that prioritizes compassion, respect, and impact. The result is a culture where people feel connected—to their colleagues, their participants, and the communities they serve.


At myPlace Health, work is more than a job. It’s a shared commitment to honoring what matters most.


The Regional Home Care Coordinator is responsible for coordinating home care services and related support for participants to ensure services are delivered safely, effectively, and in alignment with each individualized plan of care. As a member of the Interdisciplinary Team, this role completes home\-based assessments, supports care planning, monitors service delivery, coordinates with contracted providers and community\-based resources, and provides nursing care within the Licensed Vocational Nurse scope of practice as needed.


The role also supports participant and caregiver education, documentation, quality oversight, and day\-to\-day coordination of home care services, durable medical equipment, and related needs. This regional position requires regular travel to participant homes and work from the PACE center to support care coordination, documentation, and administrative responsibilities across assigned sites.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Coordinate home care services through contracted agencies to ensure services are delivered in accordance with each participant’s individualized plan of care, authorized service needs, and program standards.
* Participate as an active member of the Interdisciplinary Team by completing home assessments, reassessments, change\-of\-condition evaluations, care planning activities, and ongoing review of participant home care needs.
* Provide nursing care within the Licensed Vocational Nurse scope of practice, including wellness checks, medication administration, wound care, and other assigned clinical services in the home, clinic, and day center as needed.
* Monitor participant condition and home care service delivery through collaboration with home care staff and external agencies, and report changes in condition, treatment concerns, or adverse reactions to the Registered Nurse, Physician, or other appropriate team members.
* Educate participants and caregivers on in\-home care needs, safety practices, and self\-management strategies to promote participant independence, well\-being, and continuity of care.
* Respond to participant and family questions or concerns related to home care services in a timely, professional, and service\-oriented manner.
* Schedule and coordinate home care visits and support related appointment logistics, including collaboration with transportation staff to ensure timely and accurate participant service coordination.
* Oversee and monitor services provided by contracted home care agencies to support quality, consistency, and compliance with applicable regulatory and organizational requirements.
* Document all nursing care, care coordination, assessments, and service\-related activities in the electronic medical record within established timeframes to ensure accuracy, continuity, and regulatory compliance.
* Support home care operations and team effectiveness by participating in care coordination meetings, updating care plans as needed, and assisting with the training and orientation of new home care staff.

* We seek Rebels who are curious about AI and its power to transform how we operate and serve our members.
* Actively support the achievement of myPlace's Vision and Goals.
* Other duties as assigned.

* Current, active Licensed Vocational Nurse (LVN) license in the State of California
* CPR and First Aid certification required within 60 days of hire
* Experience providing care to frail and elderly adults
* Travel 50% of the time covering both Downtown Los Angeles \& Compton locations
* Valid California driver’s license, insurance and reliable personal transportation
* Strong verbal, written, and organizational skills
* Ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary team environment
* Proficiency in computer applications, typing, and electronic medical record systems
* Ability to maintain professionalism, exercise sound judgment, and respond effectively under pressure
* Demonstrated dependability, flexibility, and commitment to quality and ethical standards
* Compassion, patience, and respect in working with older adults and their families
* Prior experience in home care or community\-based care settings preferred

**About the Fund for Guaranteed Income**

The Fund for Guaranteed Income (F4GI) directs power and resources into the hands of the people — so everyone can determine the course of their lives.

We partner with community organizations and governments to run pilot programs that reimagine systems, including the social safety net and the criminal legal system, and advocate for more efficient, dignified, and inclusive forms of support.

To date, most of our work involves direct cash transfers. We built the Compton Pledge — the largest city\-based guaranteed income program in US history — and have supported more than 20 pilot programs nationwide. We design and implement pilot programs, build technology, and conduct research to make the case for policies that meaningfully expand support.

Beyond cash, we build tools that address the broader needs of the communities we serve. Over the past five years, our positive\-impact technology projects have assisted some of the hardest\-to\-reach community members.

**About the AI Dividend**

AI is impacting jobs that provide security and mobility for millions of Americans. Yet our ability to respond is at a particularly weak point, hurt by uncertainty about the speed and scale of AI's impact.

Fortunately, we don't need to know the future to start preparing.

The AI Dividend is a pilot program that provides income support and reskilling to workers displaced by AI, generating data needed for an effective response. We are exploring:

* How to identify AI displacement on an individual level
* How workers navigate and overcome AI displacement
* How income support can support the road to re\-employment

The AI Dividend is the latest program from the Fund for Guaranteed Income (F4GI), a 501(c)(3\) nonprofit organization that has run more than 20 cash transfer programs nationwide.

**The AI Dividend is not a guaranteed income pilot program.** We aim to test both cash and alternative forms of support to understand what displaced workers are asking for — and what really helps people overcome AI displacement.

**The role**

The AI Dividend is seeking a member of the founding team to help build this program from the ground up. As Program Manager, you will work directly with F4GI's Executive Director and our core team to keep the program organized, remove distractions, and solve problems so we can learn as much as possible from each stage of the program and scale.

The AI Dividend is run by a small, core team. Like a startup, every person wears multiple hats and is expected to play a role in different areas of the project.

Your work will be concentrated in:

* **Program Operations**: Making sure the program is running smoothly, finding and proposing solutions to pain points.
* **Program Design**: Connecting with directly impacted workers, workforce development providers, and AI researchers to ensure their input and expertise are built into the DNA of this program.
* **Program Strategy**: Helping us stay connected to what is most important and triage between competing priorities.

Your work will also touch on:

* **Fundraising**: Supporting our team in finding partners interested in supporting our growth.
* **Research**: Coordinating research activities (interviews, surveys) and keeping outputs organized.
* **External Communications**: Contributing to our work sharing the impact and stories from this program more broadly.

**How do I know if I'm a good fit?**

The AI Dividend is being built in real time — the work involves a lot of unknowns and experimentation. We are looking for someone with:

* experience in a small startup or similar fast\-paced environment who is comfortable working with uncertainty and ambiguity
* a demonstrated track record of making good decisions, quickly, with limited information — and pivoting when things don't work out
* a bias for action and a love of feedback — you understand the concept of "best right now"
* a strong personal organization system — you ask questions and gather context intuitively so you always know what is most important

**Onboarding will be limited.** You will be expected to figure out systems and ask questions so you can hit the ground running.

You are expected to use AI tools like Claude or ChatGPT daily. Ideal applicants are highly proficient with these tools — you have developed your own workflows and can help the team level up. Comfort with tools like Cursor is a bonus.

You are actively engaged with AI as a topic — reading, thinking, discussing, following the field. AI policy or research is a strong plus, but you don't need to have formal research or policy experience as long as you bring useful and interesting perspectives to the team. You are an excellent candidate if you can help us connect to the right partners throughout the AI space.

**How to apply**

Email careers@f4gi.org with the subject line "Program Manager — \[Your Name]" and include:

* **Your resume and LinkedIn profile.**
* **Three professional references** — we will not contact them without speaking with you first.
* **Short answers** to the following:
* What experience do you believe prepares you well to work on this team?
* What are a few examples of how you've used AI in the last week?

* What is one AI development from the last six months that changed how you think about work?
* What tools or techniques do you use to stay organized?

myPlace Health is built around a simple but powerful belief: older adults deserve the support they need to live safely, independently, and with dignity in their own communities. As a PACE (Program of All Inclusive Care for the Elderly) organization backed by SCAN Group, myPlace Health brings together customized medical care, social activities, and daily support for participants and their families – all under one roof.


Our centers are more than healthcare facilities. They are vibrant community hubs where participants are known by name, valued, and supported as whole people. Behind that experience is a dedicated, interdisciplinary team working together to coordinate care, remove barriers, and improve quality of life for some of the most medically and socially complex populations.


For employees, myPlace Health offers the opportunity to do deeply meaningful work in a highly collaborative setting. Team members are encouraged to contribute innovative ideas, and grow alongside a mission that prioritizes compassion, respect, and impact. The result is a culture where people feel connected—to their colleagues, their participants, and the communities they serve.


At myPlace Health, work is more than a job. It’s a shared commitment to honoring what matters most.


The Regional Home Care Coordinator is responsible for coordinating home care services and related support for participants to ensure services are delivered safely, effectively, and in alignment with each individualized plan of care. As a member of the Interdisciplinary Team, this role completes home\-based assessments, supports care planning, monitors service delivery, coordinates with contracted providers and community\-based resources, and provides nursing care within the Licensed Vocational Nurse scope of practice as needed.


The role also supports participant and caregiver education, documentation, quality oversight, and day\-to\-day coordination of home care services, durable medical equipment, and related needs. This regional position requires regular travel to participant homes and work from the PACE center to support care coordination, documentation, and administrative responsibilities across assigned sites.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Coordinate home care services through contracted agencies to ensure services are delivered in accordance with each participant’s individualized plan of care, authorized service needs, and program standards.
* Participate as an active member of the Interdisciplinary Team by completing home assessments, reassessments, change\-of\-condition evaluations, care planning activities, and ongoing review of participant home care needs.
* Provide nursing care within the Licensed Vocational Nurse scope of practice, including wellness checks, medication administration, wound care, and other assigned clinical services in the home, clinic, and day center as needed.
* Monitor participant condition and home care service delivery through collaboration with home care staff and external agencies, and report changes in condition, treatment concerns, or adverse reactions to the Registered Nurse, Physician, or other appropriate team members.
* Educate participants and caregivers on in\-home care needs, safety practices, and self\-management strategies to promote participant independence, well\-being, and continuity of care.
* Respond to participant and family questions or concerns related to home care services in a timely, professional, and service\-oriented manner.
* Schedule and coordinate home care visits and support related appointment logistics, including collaboration with transportation staff to ensure timely and accurate participant service coordination.
* Oversee and monitor services provided by contracted home care agencies to support quality, consistency, and compliance with applicable regulatory and organizational requirements.
* Document all nursing care, care coordination, assessments, and service\-related activities in the electronic medical record within established timeframes to ensure accuracy, continuity, and regulatory compliance.
* Support home care operations and team effectiveness by participating in care coordination meetings, updating care plans as needed, and assisting with the training and orientation of new home care staff.

* Actively support the achievement of myPlace's Vision and Goals.
* Other duties as assigned.

* Current, active Licensed Vocational Nurse (LVN) license in the State of California
* CPR and First Aid certification required within 60 days of hire
* Experience providing care to frail and elderly adults
* Travel 50% of the time covering both Downtown Los Angeles \& Compton locations
* Valid California driver’s license, insurance and reliable personal transportation
* Strong verbal, written, and organizational skills
* Ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary team environment
* Proficiency in computer applications, typing, and electronic medical record systems
* Ability to maintain professionalism, exercise sound judgment, and respond effectively under pressure
* Demonstrated dependability, flexibility, and commitment to quality and ethical standards
* Compassion, patience, and respect in working with older adults and their families
* Prior experience in home care or community\-based care settings preferred

Across all of this, we are united by a shared commitment: combining compassion with discipline, innovation with stewardship, and growth with integrity.


At SCAN, we believe scale should strengthen—not dilute—our mission. We are building the future of care for older adults, grounded in purpose, accountability, and respect for the people and communities we serve.

**The Job**


The Patient Care Coordinator will support SCAN clinicians and coordinate care for SCAN members to achieve SCAN’s mission of keeping seniors healthy and independent.
